method: Reviewed the official City Legistar matter record and every official attachment. Downloaded and extracted originals, compared SHA-256 values and normalized extracted text, and rendered the signed enactment because it has no usable text layer.

matter.title: Approving the Menaul Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Plan

attachments.title: R-22-92 original resolution packet
attachments.reason: The proposed resolution packet includes an unenacted resolution and an earlier attached plan version. The independently attached final plan and signed enactment are the canonical substantive and governing records.

attachments.title: R-22-92 adopted Menaul MRA Plan final
attachments.reason: Different PDF bytes from the existing archive, but exact normalized extracted-text match across all 156,047 characters. It is the same adopted May 2023 plan and is retained once as canonical.

attachments.title: R-22-92 enacted resolution
attachments.reason: Visually verified signed R-2023-037: Council adopted it 9-0 on May 1, 2023, and the Mayor approved it May 18. It separately approves and incorporates the Menaul MRA Plan into the City Code of Resolutions.

result: Retain the existing adopted plan once and add the signed approval resolution as the distinct governing action. Do not retain the original mixed proposal packet.
